parts.question_text:

Nucleus Q is unstable and emits a β^{-} particle to form nucleus R.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
A hadron consists of two charm quarks and one bottom quark.
Determine, in terms of the elementary charge e, the charge of the hadron.
charge = e
